$comment: Tripo 访客流水线的清单（node scripts/tripo/visitors.mjs --dry-run 先看会发什么、花多少）。
status: draft = 草稿，--run 只做到换装图（每个约 10 积分）。看过 assets-src/visitors/<id>/costume.png 满意后改成 approved，才会做 3D、绑骨、动作（每个约 95 积分）。
reference: 吉祥物参考图，可以是文件，也可以是目录（目录里只能有一张 PNG / JPEG / WebP）。
每个访客可以用 overrides 覆盖 defaults 里的任何字段；值写 null 表示删掉这个字段。改了已经做过的步骤会停下来提示 --reroll，不会悄悄重做。
价格表在 scripts/tripo/catalog.mjs（developers.tripo3d.ai/en/pricing，2026-10-27 读取）。下面四套服装都是草稿，等用户确认。
2026-10-28：按翠宝的造型改写（黑色球形身体、正面 logo、半透明灰色手臂、黄色球鞋，没有脸）：服装是玩具配件式的帽子、披肩、领子和手绘花纹。

prep.$comment: 共用的预处理：先把参考图里的吉祥物摆成 T 姿势（image-to-image 的 t_pose 模板），四套服装都从这张图出发，比例一致，也更好绑骨。参考图如果只有头像或扁平 logo，在前面加 "figure"（生成全身）；已经是端正的全身站姿可以把 templates 写成 []。

costume.$comment: chat_image_2.5_sunburst：文档说它「编辑时最大程度保留没改动的部分」，适合换装但不改脸；quality=medium 与 low 同价（2K 10 积分）。想省钱换 seedream_v5（5 积分），同时在 overrides 里写 "quality": null。
costume.promptTemplate: Dress this character in a Halloween costume: {costume}. It must stay clearly the same mascot: a round matte-black ball body with its gold-and-white logo on the front still visible, short black legs, translucent grey arms and yellow sneakers; do not give it a face or a human torso. The costume fits the round body like accessories on a vinyl toy figure: hats, capes, collars, straps and paint. Keep exactly the same pose, camera angle and framing, full body visible from top to sneakers, facing the viewer. Victorian gothic, restrained and realistic: well-made, slightly worn materials in muted colours (charcoal, oxblood, moss green, tarnished brass), no glow, no added text, nothing held in the hands. Both legs stay visible and separate. Plain light grey seamless background, soft even lighting.

touchup.$comment: 2026-10-28 加：换装图上只改点名的地方，其余不动；建模用修过的图（assets-src/visitors/<id>/touchup.png）。默认修手：T 字站姿那步把翠宝的手（三根手指加拇指，掌心有小星星）画成了五指，四张换装都跟着错了。访客自己的 touchup 字段接在 {extra} 处。source = local：修图在公司素材中台（vmc）上做（用户 2026-10-28 指定），挑好的图复制成 touchup.png，母版留在 assets/generated/vmc/<任务ID>/；promptTemplate / request 只在 source 不是 local 时用（走 Tripo 的 image-to-image）。
touchup.promptTemplate: Edit this image of a mascot figure. Change only what is listed here. 1) Hands: each translucent grey glove hand must have exactly three fingers and one thumb, four digits in total, like a classic cartoon glove, with soft rounded fingertips and a tiny four-pointed sparkle on the palm; keep the hands the same size, colour and translucency, and keep both arms stretched straight out to the sides exactly as they are. {extra} Everything else stays exactly as it is: the ball body, the logo, the costume, the legs, the sneakers, the pose, the framing, the background and the lighting.

views.$comment: 只有 route = multiview 时用：换装图 → 四视图 → multiview-to-model，背面（斗篷、披肩）更准，每个访客多 10 积分。2026-10-28 起四套都走：第三人称里玩家多半从背后看访客（docs/research/2026-10-28-glimmerby-api-models.md）。

model.$comment: 2026-10-28 按用户「用最好的模型」改成 P2-20260801（文档定位 game assets，"easier to edit, rig, and animate"；Preview 版）：三角面、face_limit 13000（给 Blender 精修留余量）、贴图 v3.5 + detailed + delight（游戏全靠实时打光，底色要去掉烘焙的光照）= 120 积分。P2 不支持 smart_low_poly / geometry_quality。效果不好时退回 H3.1：{"model": "v3.1-20260211", "smart_low_poly": true, "face_limit": 12000}（50 积分）。依据见 docs/research/2026-10-28-glimmerby-api-models.md。

rig.$comment: v1.0-20240301 只做人形，但有 90+ 个预设动作（害怕、张望都在里面）；v2.5 / v3.0 只有 11 个。spec=mixamo：Mixamo 兼容的骨骼名，以后能从 Mixamo 补动作。

animate.$comment: 键对应 src/config/character.ts 的 clips（idle / walk / run / scared），一次 retarget 最多 5 个，每个 10 积分。上次试玩说访客动作太夸张，先选平实的；想加「张望」就加一行 "lookAround": "preset:biped:look_around"（+10 积分，同一次请求里）。

convert.$comment: 默认关。导出时如果检查出贴图大于 2048，再打开它（高级转换 10 积分/个）。未核实：convert 能不能直接吃 retarget 的 task_id、format=GLTF 回来是不是 .glb。

refine.$comment: 导出前用本机 Blender 精修（scripts/blender/refine_visitor.py）：球身、帽子、披风整块跟着肩膀那节脊柱骨，腿边的配件不跟腿拉伸，清碎片，面数 / 贴图限到游戏预算，去根运动。结果 assets-src/visitors/<id>/refined.glb，预览表 refine-preview/<id>-sheet.png。args 传给 refine_visitor.py，比如 ["--limb-scale", "1.6"]（腿 / 手臂的管子算粗一点）、["--spine-damp", "0.6"]（脊柱晃动减到 60%）。

variants.label: 提灯夜行的探险家
variants.costume: a Victorian night explorer: a small flat tweed cap perched on top of the ball, a short olive waxed shoulder cape with brass buttons draped over the back and shoulders, a narrow leather satchel strap across the ball, a small unlit brass lantern clipped at one side, leather gaiters over the sneakers
variants.notes: 灯挂在身侧、手里空着：游戏会在访客手边画手电。 2026-10-28：吸血鬼试做通过后批准做 3D（用户：「Either is fine」，按「试做没问题再做剩下的」）。

variants.label: 维多利亚吸血鬼
variants.costume: a restrained Victorian vampire: a tall stand-up black collar behind the ball and a short black cape lined with deep oxblood red draped down the back, ending above the legs; a white silk cravat with a small garnet pin just below the logo; no fangs, no blood, no bat wings
variants.notes: 斗篷只搭在背后、不拖到腿上：绑骨后走路不会被扯着变形。 2026-10-28：用户同意做 3D（「Either is fine」），先做这一个试 P2 + 四视图 + Blender 精修。

variants.label: 女巫（尖帽和毛线披肩）
variants.costume: a Victorian witch: a tall black felt witch hat with a slightly bent tip and a modest brim on top of the ball, a hand-knitted charcoal wool shawl with a fringe draped around the shoulders below the logo, a sprig of dried lavender in the hat band, dark striped socks above the sneakers
variants.notes: 帽檐不宽：宽帽檐容易和球身粘成一块。 2026-10-28：吸血鬼试做通过后批准做 3D（用户：「Either is fine」，按「试做没问题再做剩下的」）。

variants.label: 手绘骷髅连身衣
variants.costume: a homemade skeleton costume: the black ball body hand-painted with a slightly faded off-white ribcage and spine pattern around the logo without covering it, and painted bones along the arms and legs
variants.touchup: 2) Remove the top hat with its roses and brooches, the brooch above the logo, and the tattered lace cape with its lace trim, so that the round matte-black ball body is bare apart from the painted off-white bones; where those items were, show the same smooth matte-black ball surface and the same plain light grey background. Keep the painted ribcage, spine and the bones on the arms and legs exactly as they are.
variants.notes: 轮廓完全不变、只加花纹：绑骨和动作最不容易出问题。2026-10-28：换装图自己加了礼帽、玫瑰和破蕾丝披风（没要），touchup 里去掉。 2026-10-28：吸血鬼试做通过后批准做 3D（用户：「Either is fine」，按「试做没问题再做剩下的」）。
